name: claude-mission-control
description: Local web dashboard to supervise Claude Code sessions in near real-time (fleet status, consumption metrics).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.backup: npm run build -w server && npm run backup -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
